summary.description: Hexabromobiphenyl is a white solid used as a fire retardant primarily in plastics for electrical appliances. It is non-volatile and non-flammable.
environmental_impact: Highly persistent and bio-accumulates in the environment
Exposure to high levels can cause skin problems, immune and nervous system damage, and affect liver and kidneys
May cause cancer and has long-term harmful effects on aquatic life

top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: Hexabromobiphenyl poses significant health risks including skin, immune, nervous system damage, organ toxicity, and potential carcinogenicity.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: Its persistence and bioaccumulative nature emphasize the need for responsible management in production and disposal of fire retardant plastics.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG14_Life_Below_Water: The pollutant bio-accumulates and has long-term toxic effects on aquatic life, threatening marine ecosystems.
